question: Which town of the Indus Valley Civilisation literally means 'mound of the dead'?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Mohenjo-Daro**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Mohenjo-daro is the Indus Valley Civilization town that literally translates to "mound of the dead.
 
• After a year of discovery of the of Harappa, the archaeological site of Mohenjo-Daro was recognized in 1922.
